paragraphs: Rav Kahana, son of Rav Nechunya, [Taanit 24b](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.24b.3).[^1]

notes.text: Midrash Tehillim reads Rabbi Avdimi beRabbi Nechunya. Both Bavli passages give the father’s title as Rav Nechunya. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2013&lang=en) cites the Berakhot occurrence. The shared patronymic does not establish a single father.
